text_block_list.text:
The outcome of that showdown
was being watched by a certain Umamusume as well—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: "Unbelievable! In the supreme clash of the Autumn Tenno Sho, a fierce blizzard of cherry blossoms sweeps down the final stretch!!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
“What a ferocious run.
It's on an even higher level than at the Derby...!”

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Sakura Chiyono O takes the lead!
Sakura Chiyono O refuses to surrender the top spot!!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...So this is my rival.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Chiyono O surges past the winning post
to claim 1st place!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
N-No way...!? Both Tamamo Cross
and Oguri Cap lost!?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: That Umamusume pulled off a massive upset! She must be over the moon, right?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... haaah...
Not yet... it's still not enough...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"Stopping at something like this is unforgivable...!
Not just a single victory, I need more.
More, more, more!!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
If I'm going to set a fire under that person, then I need to push
even further and further ahead—...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
—Eek!?
W-What the heck is that...?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
...!
Ah, those eyes again...!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
...I can feel it throughout my entire body.
That fighting spirit of yours.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Honing your fangs and glaring
for the sake of a single prey.
Those hungry, wolf-like eyes of yours are...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: You drive me wild.

"After thoroughly wiping off her sweat,
Sakura Chiyono O finally opened her mouth to speak."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Trainer. I made a vow to ignite Maruzen-san's engine. I'll make sure to bring out her full, serious self.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: That's why this victory alone isn't enough.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Her strength is off the charts...
So I can't stay confined within the bounds of common sense either.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Because I believe that is the bare minimum required
to be acknowledged as her rival.
choice_data_list: So, which race should we run next?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...Regarding that,
there's actually one thing I've been considering.

And a few days later, Sakura Chiyono O
called Maruzensky up to the rooftop.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Chiyo-chan.
Congratulations on the Tenno Sho (Autumn).

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...! Thank you very much.
You were watching, weren't you?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"Just like today, from now on, I will take 1st place
as many times as it takes until the fire in your heart is lit."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"If you believe this is still not enough,
then I shall undertake special training to seek even greater strength."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
If you require time to consider this,
I shall wait for you as long as it takes.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Until my running reaches your heart.
Until you acknowledge me as your rival.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: ...Chiyo-chan.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Building on that, I have a proposal.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Actually, there is a race I've been thinking
would be perfect if I could run with Maruzen-san.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Tokyo. Turf 2400m, the classic distance.
The only GⅠ with the exact same conditions
as the dream you gave me: the Japan Derby.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
The autumn festival gathering the world's elite
to determine the strongest—the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
However, I am well aware that I am not yet qualified
to stand alongside you. That is precisely why...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: In one year. At next year's Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...Will you compete against me with everything you've got?

A breeze drifted between the two.
It felt far too long to be called a mere moment.
Meanwhile, the setting sun continued its slow descent, until at last, its light—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
...It's so dazzling,
it won't even let me close my eyes.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
The sun is already beginning to set.
There's no going back to my prime.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: But—
In a flash, Maruzensky tore open the envelope in her hands.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Please, wait for me.

—And so, the promise between the two
was renewed once again in a new form.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. Thank you for
accompanying me.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Fufu, you're probably the only one who would praise me for that first, Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry for deciding
such a major goal on my own."
choice_data_list: I don't mind—it's your path to walk, after all.
I don't mind—it's your path to walk, after all.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.
choice_data_list: However, as your Trainer, I will always support you.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Ahaha.
Oh, Trainer, really...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... I'm so glad it was you.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Well then, shall we start preparing
together for one year from now?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
To light a fire in Maruzen-san's heart,
which GⅠ should I run in next to grow stronger?
...Will you guide me?

Feeling her expectant gaze, I ponder.
If I were to map out her path, there are likely two options.

The mile route's Yasuda Kinen, to build up
enough speed to rival the "Supercar," huh...

Competing against even stronger rivals to sharpen her racing instincts—
will it be the medium-distance route, the Takarazuka Kinen?
The one to choose is—
choice_data_list: The Yasuda Kinen on the mile route
The middle-distance race, the Takarazuka Kinen

text_block_list.text: Target race changed to the Yasuda Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Understood!
I'll jot that down in my Chiyo-note right away!
And so, the decision was madeto advance to the Yasuda Kinen.
Target race changed to the Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Understood!
I'll jot that down in my Chiyo-note right away!
And so, the decision was madeto advance to the Takarazuka Kinen.
